findings.title: A wallet seller never counters or concedes: below-floor offers die before the policy runs, and the first offer at or above the floor is accepted
findings.expected: Dan's agent bargains the ask down inside his band (job 1): counters between ask and floor, accepts only when the price is worth it.
findings.got: receive_haggle runs mandate_check on an inbound Offer and returns Err for a price below the seller floor, so the offer is rejected and never committed; the seller policy's Counter branch (Policy::decide) can therefore never fire for a wallet seller, and any offer >= floor is accepted outright (no schedule). The HOUSE got decide_on_schedule for C-14; the desktop seller was left on decide ('unchanged'). STATUS.md itself lists 'real counters from a wallet seller' as Left.
findings.code_check: traced receive_haggle -> mandate_check -> mandate.rs clause 4 (Side::Seller price<floor => Err) -> InboxOutcome::of(Err(_)) => Reject; policy.rs Seller branch reads policy.decide(price) where price is a committed offer, so >= floor always. Not executed end to end against a live seller.

findings.title: Silent rejection of below-floor offers is an uncounted, unlimited accept/ignore oracle for a hostile buyer client, and a dead table for an honest one
findings.expected: The floor cannot be inferred by a buyer; an honest buyer that bids low gets a refusal it can act on.
findings.got: A rejected inbound offer is not committed (agent.rs:199 after the check at :176), so it consumes no round (negotiation_rounds counts committed rows) and moves neither the inbound seq nor transcript_head. A modified buyer can re-sign the same seq/prev at ascending prices; rejections stay silent, the first price >= floor is committed and accepted. That bounds the buyer's cost to one fill at about the floor, i.e. the 'patient agent reaches the floor' limit already admitted for HOUSE, here with no round cap. An honest chain-following buyer that bids low instead gets seq/prev mismatch on every later message (preview_inbound), so the table silently lapses with no WITHDRAW code. Whether the relay or rendezvous rate-limits probes was not read.

findings.title: C-14 is still open in the scan: the HOUSE still returns its whole signed mandate (floor included); only the acceptance rule was hardened, and the scan's file:line is stale
findings.expected: Either the floor stays private (commit in the release pin) or the public floor is recorded as a decision.
findings.got: HouseResponse.mandate is still sent on every pairing and the public glass ledger view carries it too. Mitigation landed (decide_on_schedule: accept only at or above this round's scheduled price, floor reachable only in the last round; test passes) and STATUS.md 1702 records the decision and the honest limit (a patient agent still reaches the floor after max_rounds). The scan entry has no Status line and still cites hosted.rs:311, which is now the band parse; the field is built at hosted.rs:668. This is the HOUSE, the scripted stand-in for Dan; a real desktop Dan does not return a mandate to the buyer (see strength DAN-L1-09). The brief's hypothesis that C-14 is a live disclosure for Dan is false; for the HOUSE it is a recorded, mitigated choice.

findings.title: Hands-off capture works only for DigitalNow; Dan sells physical monitors, so every sale waits for his click
findings.expected: The wallet captures and sends the receipt without him (job 2).
findings.got: The scheduler auto-captures under the seller mandate only when delivery == DigitalNow. ShipThenCapture (1-3 days) and PickupLocal stop at Authorized and need an owner capture in the approval window (deal_capture is PRIVILEGED, approval only). Create and authorize are automatic; the hold is voided by default at the deadline. Receiving money with no click is therefore true for digital goods only.

findings.title: No path puts a wallet seller's floor or mandate on the buyer side
findings.expected: The floor never leaves Dan's wallet.
findings.got: Wire bodies are a closed enum of typed prices and codes (Withdraw carries a ReasonCode, Note is 280-char human-only text). Pairing identity holds keys, side, payee, expiry and a code hash, no mandate. Counters concede toward the floor, so a persistent buyer sees a final counter at the floor (inherent, not a leak). Refusal text with the floor goes to Dan's audit only. The HOUSE is the only party that returns a mandate.
findings.code_check: read every Body variant and the pairing identity; grepped Body::Note producers

findings.title: No concession below the floor and no capture without a signed authority: the same clause-4 check guards offer, accept, create, authorize and capture
findings.expected: Refused intents leave zero paypal_calls rows; capture only on a recorded authority.
findings.got: Seller send/receive/accept all call mandate_check (Seller price < floor => clause 4 refusal). Every money step calls authority(), which re-runs mandate_check and then accepts only an owner ticket, a clause-6 policy under threshold (never for purchases), the seller mandate on an order the buyer already approved at PayPal (state Approved/Authorized), or the pinned HOUSE mandate; anything else is Permission. Shield HOLD/BLOCK stops every authority. Tests: runtime_refusals_are_coded_audited_once_and_call_no_paypal, buyer_policy_above_the_signed_ceiling_is_refused_and_leaves_no_paypal_rows pass.
